method: UHF (NWChem: xc hfexch 1.0 slater eps, eps -> 0 extrapolated)
ao_order: ferric (NWChem rows multiplied by nwchem_to_ferric_ao_sign; verified, see generator doc)

keywords.xc: hfexch (unconstrained); hfexch 1.0 slater eps (constrained), eps in [1e-07, 2e-07, 3e-07]
keywords.cdft: cdft 1 1 charge 0.20000000000000018 pop becke convergence 1e-10; cdft_maxiter 200
keywords.grid: lebedev <nrad> <iang> becke treutler; set dft:no_prune T
keywords.integrals: direct, tolerances tight, no density fitting
keywords.partition: ferric_partition variant: atoms retagged None with per-atom nuclear charge restored
keywords.pyscf_check: PySCF UHF energy_tot + Becke populations of the exported orbitals

grid.matched: 99x302 Treutler(Perez-Jorda Chebyshev) x Lebedev, Becke size-adjusted, unpruned
grid.converged: 300x974 Treutler(Perez-Jorda Chebyshev) x Lebedev, Becke size-adjusted, unpruned

stability.note: NWChem has no cDFT stability analysis; the Rust test measures ferric's lambda-augmented internal stability at each seeded state
